title: Team Fortress 2
provenance: reported by hayden9002 (highball-db#11), Apple M5 Pro, unverified by Highball
notes: Plays. Reported on an M5 Pro with DXMT and msync: mouse movement feels unsynced and snappy, with noticeable stutter while moving the mouse, at a steady 59.95 fps with no spikes. The Vulkan path (MoltenVK) stutters more; D3DMetal stutters less than that, about the same as DXMT. Not tried here.

anticheat.note: VAC is userspace and runs under Wine; Counter-Strike 2 plays online under it here

knownIssues.symptom: Mouse movement feels unsynced and snappy, with stutter while moving the mouse (M5 Pro, DXMT, msync).
knownIssues.fix: None recorded yet. A report saying whether raw input is on in the game's mouse settings, and which renderer, would help.
